title: Claims about passes in the pinned LLVM
description: The shape of tests/llvm_scope/coverage.json. tests/llvm_scope.py checks the rules this schema can't say: that each pass exists in inventory.json, that evidence files exist with the hash given, that complete needs evidence of the right kind and no gaps, that a code binding names the pinned source's anchors exactly, and that translation validation is never complete.

pin.description: The tag inventory.json was generated from.

item.description: An id from inventory.json, such as pass:instcombine.

dimension.description: all-input: every rewrite the pass can make is proved for every permitted input. analysis-soundness: what the analysis reports is proved true of every input. code-binding: the pass's C++ at the pinned anchors is proved to make only the proved rewrites. composition: the pass is proved correct inside every pipeline it runs in, with the analyses it reads and preserves. translation-validation: certificates for finitely many inputs, which never make a pass done.

contexts.description: "all", or the opt pipelines and llc targets and levels the claim covers, as contexts_of() names them, such as opt:default<O2> or llc:x86-64:O2. registered covers running the pass by name. Only "all" can make a pass done.

status.description: Anything but complete is unfinished. A timeout is never a pass.

path.description: A file in the repo, relative to its root.

command.description: How to check the evidence again.

anchors.description: For code-binding: each source file the binding covers, with its hash. A complete binding must name exactly the pass's anchors in inventory.json.

gaps.description: What the claim doesn't cover. Must be empty for complete.
